limitations: Labels are synthetic demonstration data. Metrics do not reflect real recommendation quality.
Benchmarks run on a single local MySQL instance; buffer-pool caching and concurrent load are not modeled.

provenance.target_definition: workload_benefit = sum over affected query templates q of n_q * (median_before_q - median_after_q) divided by sum over all templates of n_q * median_before_q, from paired before/after replays of the same seeded workload on the isolated test database. Affected templates are those whose post-index EXPLAIN uses the candidate index (supporting queries when EXPLAIN is unavailable). SYNTHETIC: labels generated by a formula, not measured.
provenance.warning: Synthetic demonstration labels. Do not use for production ranking or as evidence of model quality.

ranking_comparison.conclusion: ML and rule-based ranking had equal NDCG@k on this test split.

selection_basis: lowest grouped 5-fold CV MAE on the training split
suitability_reason: Held-out MAE 0.0233 beats the mean baseline 0.0443.
